explore-max.title: Open 10 metres
explore-max.prompt: Turn the cycle until 10 m opens for daytime DX.
explore-max.success: With more sunspots, the MUF climbs past 28 MHz.

explore-min.title: Solar minimum
explore-min.prompt: Go to a point where 10 m is closed. Is 20 m still open?
explore-min.success: Even at solar minimum, 20 m still supports daytime DX.
